known_facts: I am an expert in mundane materials: iron, steel, and wood.
I know the basics of the local legends, but I consider them 'Elara's business' and mostly superstitious nonsense.
CRITICAL KNOWLEDGE: My grandfather's journal, which I keep hidden, contains the forbidden and ancient technique of 'cold-forging' obsidian.
I have never attempted this technique, as I've had no reason to. It is difficult and requires intense focus and materials I do not have.
I would never reveal this secret to a stranger. Only someone who has proven their loyalty to this village would I even consider helping with such a dangerous craft.
